messages:
Avery Johnson: Heads up — we need to lock 3–5 design partners for the structured case study + reference program. Drop candidate accounts here w/ (1) champion strength, (2) deployment mode, (3) appetite for PUBLIC logo/quote vs reference-call-only.

Avery Johnson: My current list from NA side: Arcadia Health (Private/VPC), NovaDocs (Hosted + Optimize), HelioSupport (Hosted/Dedicated TBD), VectorForge (Hosted). Want to make sure we don’t over-ask too early.

Priyom Das: QuantaPay is my best shot for a *measurable* outcome story (Dedicated). Champion is solid: Priya R., Director of ML Platform (she’s been owning the POC + loops in VP Eng). They’re open to being a design partner and *conditionally* open to a case study if we hit acceptance thresholds.

Priyom Das: BUT: I’d keep the first ask to “reference-call-only during POC” and then convert to public logo/quotes after we have clean metrics + Legal ok. They’re very sensitive to wording (esp latency claims) and will redline. :grimacing:

Stephanie Nguyen: +1 on sequencing. Don’t ask for public logo on first mention unless champion is already pushing it.

Stephanie Nguyen: Proposed rule of thumb:
- If it’s a PLG-friendly SaaS (NovaDocs/VectorForge style) → ok to ask public earlier.
- If regulated/fintech/insurance → start reference-only, then upgrade to public once approvals + security language are nailed.

Hannah Schmitt: EMEA update: Moonlake Insurance (backup candidate) has a strong technical champion (Head of Data Platforms) but comms/publicity is *hard*. They’re already asking about data residency + “no vendor names in public materials.”

Hannah Schmitt: I can pursue them for reference-call-only (and potentially an anonymized story). Public logo/quote feels unlikely.

Lukas Meyer: Agree w/ Hannah. Moonlake could still be valuable for late-stage EMEA deals even if it’s just 1–2 reference calls/quarter. Keep them warm.

Rachel Kim: From CS POV: before we put anyone into the “reference ready” bucket, want to confirm:
1) Stable prod usage or at least stable POC results (no open Sev-1/Sev-2 issues)
2) Clear champion + backup contact
3) They understand boundaries (what’s in/out on calls)

Rachel Kim: For regulated accounts: we can do reference calls without architecture diagrams. For public case studies, we’ll need a lot more review cycles.

Avery Johnson: Arcadia Health — champion is strong (platform lead + security stakeholder shows up). They *will* require VPC language + audit log specifics and they’re careful about what can be published.

Avery Johnson: I’m leaning: Arcadia = reference-call-only first, and we pitch an anonymized “healthcare platform team” story later if they won’t go public with name/logo.

Miguel Santos: Arcadia has been responsive, but their security review cadence is slow. If we ask for public now we’ll burn cycles. Reference-only should be fine + we can prep them with the one-pager.

Grace O'Connor: For NovaDocs, champion looks very “marketing friendly” (founder + PM both engaged). If you want, I can send a quick feeler email from SDR side like “would you be open to a public customer story?” and gauge reaction before the formal release form.

Avery Johnson: NovaDocs — yes. They’re excited about architecture diagrams and talking about cost per query. I’ll own the formal ask (public case study + logo/quote), but Grace feeler would help.

Priyom Das: VectorForge — anyone own them? They were enthusiastic on structured output + tool calling. Feels like potential “dev tools / code assistant” story, but I don’t know if they’ll do public.

Avery Johnson: VectorForge is in my patch (sort of). Champion is the Eng Manager building the assistant. I can try to get them to reference-call-only first. If they’re cool, we can upgrade to public.

Stephanie Nguyen: Let’s be crisp on ownership so customers don’t get multiple asks.
- QuantaPay: Priyom owns ask + sequencing
- Arcadia: Avery owns (reference-only first)
- NovaDocs: Avery owns (public ok)
- Moonlake: Hannah owns (reference-only / anonymized)

Lukas Meyer: Works for me.

Rachel Kim: Also: please loop CS in BEFORE we promise anything about “how often reference calls happen.” Some teams will say yes then ghost when it becomes 2 calls/week.

Priyom Das: For QuantaPay, I’ll propose: max 1 call/month, 30 min, pre-brief required, and we’ll always provide agenda + do/don’t topics.

Avery Johnson: Same for Arcadia. They’ve explicitly asked to avoid sharing infra provider details + anything about audit log retention windows.

HubSpot: Task created: "Reference program candidate - NovaDocs (public interest check + ask)" assigned to Avery Johnson. Due: 2024-11-04.

Grace O'Connor: I’ll draft a short “interest check” note for NovaDocs and send to Avery for approval.

Hannah Schmitt: For Moonlake, I’ll ask if they’d do (a) reference call only and (b) whether an anonymized story is acceptable. If they say no to both, we’ll drop.

Stephanie Nguyen: Great. One more thing: who asks for logo/quote release? It should be the AE (not Marketing), with Marketing providing the form + framing. Keeps it relationship-driven.

Avery Johnson: Got it — AEs do the ask. I’ll coordinate w/ Soojin/Camila on the language + send the release form once NovaDocs confirms openness.

Priyom Das: Same. I won’t send release form to QuantaPay until after the benchmark window is done and we’ve verified p95 claims.

Rachel Kim: :thumbsup: If you tag me on each account thread when they say yes, I’ll help define boundaries + prep checklist so the first reference call doesn’t go sideways.

Avery Johnson: Action items recap:
- Avery: Arcadia = reference-only ask; NovaDocs = public case study ask; VectorForge = reference-only feel-out
- Priyom: QuantaPay = reference-only during POC, upgrade to public post-metrics
- Hannah: Moonlake = reference-only / anonymized check
- Grace: NovaDocs interest-check email draft

Avery Johnson: I’ll update the tracker after I get responses.
